hint.select: tap an element to move, resize or delete it.
hint.text: tap the page where you want to write.
hint.image: tap the page where you want to place the image.
hint.rect: drag on the page to draw the rectangle.
hint.ellipse: drag on the page to draw the ellipse.
hint.line: drag on the page to draw the line.
hint.arrow: drag from the start to the tip.
hint.ink: draw on the page, in one or several strokes.
hint.highlight: drag over the passage to highlight.
hint.whiteout: drag over the area to hide.
hint.cover: drag over the text to replace, then type the new one.

imageUnsupported: This image cannot be read. Try a PNG or JPEG file.
limitTitle: The original text cannot be edited
limitText: Text already in a PDF cannot be reliably changed in the browser. The tool therefore adds content on top.
limitCover: To correct a passage, use “Cover then rewrite”: a white cover, then your new text.
empty: Add at least one element to a page.
